title: payload_error_predicate_only
description: 422 error variant returned by GET /v1/audit/payload?run_id=... when the targeted receipt is predicate-only-by-design (signed_predicate IS the audit content; no separate payload bytes were stored). Common case: receipts emitted by the JSONL session importer (MR !80) whose payload_uri uses the recurse://import/ scheme. Distinguished from 404 (resource missing) and 400 (request malformed) — the request was understood and the receipt exists; the resource just cannot be served because there are no detached bytes by design. The shape is a constrained subset of error_envelope.json with `error` pinned to `ERR_PREDICATE_ONLY`; the predicate-only payload_uri is echoed in `error_description` so SIEM forwarders + auditor diagnostics can confirm provenance without a second roundtrip. Built by Recurse.Gateway.AuditPlane.ErrorEnvelope.send_unprocessable_entity/4 from PayloadBroker.handle/1's predicate_only_imported branch (issue #60).

error.description: Pinned to ERR_PREDICATE_ONLY for this variant.

error_description.description: Human-readable explanation. Includes the predicate-only payload_uri (recurse://import/...) so the auditor can confirm provenance.

correlation_id.description: Request correlation ID; defaults to 'unknown' when absent.

attested_run_id.description: Always null for this variant (no denial receipt is emitted; the response is by-design 422, not a Cedar deny).
